description: Change a sound the account owns: overrides {seed, duration, channels} applied to its own recipe, or a whole new `recipe` (read the current one with r3_sound_read, change it, pass it here; r3_docs_read("SOUND_RECIPES.md") has the format). The sound itself never changes: the change is saved as a NEW sound ("Rotor" → "Rotor 2", or the `name` given) that links back to it, and every project and release using the old url keeps it. The answer names the user's projects still on the old url (r3_component_set moves an Audio component's url). An invalid change is refused with the path of the problem. Counts toward the 60 sounds an hour.

audioId.description: The sound to change (the account's own).

name.description: The new sound's name. Default: the old name with the next number ("Rotor 2").

overrides.description: Changes to its recipe: {seed, duration, channels}.

recipe.description: Or a whole new recipe (format "r3-sound-recipe", version 1).

name: r3_sound_update

answer.description: This answer in words: what was done, what R3 measured, decided or refused, and what to do next. The same text as the result's text block. Read it: the fields beside it are the data, this is the guidance.

title: Change a sound: make a new version of it
